title: Reduce Completed real-media proof exports
summary: Removed six transitional flat window.* aliases for Completed real-media proof helper functions while preserving the same functions on window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.
reason: Continue the namespace-first WebView cleanup stream with a scoped Completed-domain change that preserves browser-visible behavior and intentional flat entry points.
behavior_before: Completed real-media proof status, summary, detail, posture, and policy helper functions were available both through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView and as direct window.* flat aliases.
behavior_after: Those helper functions remain available through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView, while direct flat aliases are removed; renderCompletedRealMediaProof and completedRealMediaProofRows remain flat compatibility entry points.
tests_added: Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_completed_pending_proof_smoke.py to require the removed helper names through mediaPipelineCompletedView and to assert the served Completed source no longer assigns those flat aliases.
rollback_plan: Revert this change packet to restore the six direct window.* aliases, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and restore the prior flat export counts in docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md and docs/inventories/WEBVIEW_GLOBAL_EXPORT_INVENTORY.md.
